vendor/nonogram.js is a classic-script port of src/Nonogram.ts + src/Game.ts
+ src/colors.ts + src/status.ts. Touch listeners are added here: upstream
only wired mouse. Editor and Solver (web worker) are not packed — this app
is the playable Game.

The notice COPYING-nonogram.txt is packed inside the GIF as well as sitting
here.
